column1: How to use this seed list
These are STARTING POINTS — anchors that tell the daily agent what 'good taste' looks like for Melany.
• The agent uses these as examples + live web search to find NEW content each day.
• Add your own finds to any sheet — the more seeds, the sharper the agent's taste.
• Blue rows near the bottom of each sheet (cream-colored) are empty — fill them in.
• 'Why it fits Melany' helps the agent understand the VIBE, not just the topic.
1. Substack & Culture — newsletters/articles on design, zeitgeist, aesthetics
2. SG Food Sources — where-to-eat guides & food blogs
4. Design & Web Toys — beautiful interactive sites (your original seeds live here)
5. Interior Decor — home & interiors inspiration blogs
Some URLs say 'search X' — those are Substacks without a clean custom domain;
just search the name on substack.com to confirm the exact handle before wiring them in.
